faqs.question: Is the consultation really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The initial consultation is completely free and comes with no obligation to enroll.

faqs.question: How long does the session take?
faqs.answer: Most consultations last about 30 minutes — enough time to understand your needs and recommend a path.

faqs.question: Online or in person?
faqs.answer: We primarily offer online sessions via video call for flexibility. In-person options may be available depending on location.

faqs.question: Do parents need to attend?
faqs.answer: For students under 16, we recommend a parent or guardian joins. Older students may attend alone if they prefer.

faqs.question: What should I prepare?
faqs.answer: Bring recent grades, exam dates, and a short list of goals. That helps us tailor recommendations immediately.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data
privacy.intro: NextGrades takes the protection of your personal data seriously. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you use our website and learning platform, why we process it, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
privacy.contactNote: If you have questions about this policy or wish to exercise your rights, contact us at support@nextgrades.de.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller responsible for data processing on this website is NextGrades. For privacy-related enquiries, please contact us at support@nextgrades.de or via our contact page.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: We only collect data that is necessary to provide our services, improve your experience, and fulfil legal obligations. Depending on how you use NextGrades, this may include:
bullets: Account information such as name, email address, and role (student, teacher, or admin)
Profile details you choose to provide, including avatar, bio, and learning preferences
Booking and consultation information, including grade level, subjects, and goals
Payment-related data processed by our payment provider (we do not store full card numbers)
Usage data such as pages visited, resources accessed, and quiz activity
Technical data including IP address, browser type, device information, and cookies

sections.title: How we use your data
paragraphs: We use your personal data to operate the NextGrades platform, deliver tutoring services and learning materials, process bookings and payments, communicate with you about your account, and improve our website and services.

We may also send service-related emails (e.g. account verification, password reset, booking confirmations). Marketing communications are only sent where you have given consent or where permitted by law.

sections.title: Legal basis for processing
paragraphs: We process personal data on the following legal bases under the GDPR:
bullets: Contract performance — to provide the services you register for
Legitimate interests — to secure our platform, prevent fraud, and improve our offering
Consent — for optional features such as marketing emails or non-essential cookies
Legal obligation — where we must retain or disclose data to comply with applicable law

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences (such as language and theme), and understand how the site is used.
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may limit certain features of the platform.

sections.title: Third-party services
paragraphs: We work with trusted service providers who process data on our behalf, including hosting (Supabase), payment processing (Stripe), email delivery (Resend), and video conferencing (Zoom) where applicable.
These providers are contractually required to protect your data and may only use it to deliver services to NextGrades. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: Data retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law. When data is no longer needed, we delete or anonymise it in a secure manner.
Account data is generally kept for the duration of your account and for a reasonable period thereafter to handle disputes, legal claims, or regulatory requirements.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
bullets: Right of access — request a copy of the data we hold about you
Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Right to erasure — request deletion of your data where applicable
Right to restriction — limit how we use your data in certain circumstances
Right to data portability — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Right to object — object to processing based on legitimate interests
Right to withdraw consent — where processing is based on consent
Right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, or misuse. These include encrypted connections (HTTPS), access controls, and secure authentication.
No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We encourage you to use a strong password and keep your login credentials confidential.

sections.title: Children and minors
paragraphs: NextGrades provides educational services that may be used by students under 18. Where required, we recommend that a parent or guardian is involved in registration and consultations.
We do not knowingly collect personal data from children without appropriate consent where required by applicable law.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services or legal requirements. The date at the top of this page indicates when it was last revised. We encourage you to review this page periodically.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.subtitle: General Terms and Conditions for using NextGrades
terms.intro: These General Terms and Conditions govern your use of the NextGrades website and learning platform. By creating an account, booking a consultation, or purchasing a program, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully before using our services.
terms.contactNote: If anything is unclear, our team is happy to help at support@nextgrades.de.

sections.title: Scope and contracting party
paragraphs: These Terms & Conditions apply to all services offered by NextGrades through its website and online platform, including tutoring programs, learning resources, consultations, and related digital services.
The contracting party is NextGrades. Individual tutors or teachers listed on the platform act as service providers within the framework defined by NextGrades.

sections.title: Description of services
paragraphs: NextGrades provides online and hybrid tutoring, educational resources, progress tracking, AI-assisted learning tools, and consultation services focused on German school and university preparation.
The exact scope of services depends on the program or plan you select. Service descriptions, pricing, and features are published on our website and may be updated from time to time.

sections.title: Registration and user accounts
paragraphs: To access certain features, you must create an account with accurate and complete information. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account.
You must notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access to your account. NextGrades reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or applicable law.
bullets: Students and parents may register for learning services
Teachers register separately and are subject to additional onboarding requirements
One person may not share account access with unauthorised third parties

sections.title: Bookings, programs, and payments
paragraphs: Consultations, tutoring sessions, and program subscriptions are booked through our website or by agreement with our team. Prices displayed at the time of booking apply unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Payments are processed securely through our payment provider. By completing a purchase, you authorise the charge for the selected service or subscription period.
Subscription plans renew automatically unless cancelled before the renewal date, as described in the plan details at checkout.

sections.title: Cancellation and refunds
paragraphs: You may cancel a free consultation at any time before the scheduled session by contacting us or using the cancellation option provided in your confirmation.
For paid programs and subscriptions, cancellation and refund terms depend on the specific plan purchased. Unless otherwise stated, fees for completed sessions are non-refundable.
NextGrades may cancel or reschedule sessions due to tutor unavailability or technical issues. In such cases, we will offer a replacement session or appropriate credit.

sections.title: User obligations
paragraphs: You agree to use NextGrades lawfully and respectfully. The following conduct is prohibited:
bullets: Sharing account credentials or copyrighted materials without permission
Harassing tutors, staff, or other users
Uploading harmful, illegal, or misleading content
Attempting to disrupt or reverse-engineer the platform
Using the service for any purpose other than personal educational use without authorisation

sections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: All content on the NextGrades platform — including text, videos, quizzes, branding, and software — is protected by copyright and other intellectual property laws.

You receive a limited, non-transferable licence to access materials for your personal learning purposes. You may not copy, redistribute, or commercially exploit platform content without written consent from NextGrades.

sections.title: Availability and liability
paragraphs: We strive to keep the platform available and reliable, but uninterrupted access cannot be guaranteed. Maintenance, updates, or third-party outages may temporarily affect availability.

NextGrades is liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence, and for injury to life, body, or health. For slight negligence, we are liable only for breach of essential contractual obligations, limited to foreseeable typical damages.
NextGrades does not guarantee specific academic outcomes such as exam grades or admission results. Tutoring supports learning; final results depend on individual effort and external factors.

sections.title: Data protection
paragraphs: The processing of personal data is governed by our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms & Conditions. By using our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood our Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these Terms & Conditions to reflect changes in our services or legal requirements. Material changes will be communicated via email or a notice on the website. Continued use after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

sections.title: Governing law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These Terms & Conditions are governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, excluding the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG).
If you are a consumer residing in the EU, mandatory consumer protection laws of your country of residence may also apply. The courts of Germany shall have jurisdiction where permitted by law.
